# Exende

> Public hiring data, observed over time, with focused infrastructure APIs for autonomous software.

## Jobs & Hiring Data

- [Product](https://www.exende.dev/products/jobs)
- [Public overview and customer API documentation](https://www.exende.dev/docs/jobs)
- Public endpoint: `GET https://data.exende.dev/v1/public/overview`
- Public overview authentication: none
- Public overview boundary: aggregate catalogue counts and latest canonical observation only
- Customer job search, company data, accounts, onboarding credits, and scoped API keys: available
- Paid subscriptions and plan upgrades: available through the authenticated dashboard
- Credit metering: successful list/search routes cost 1 credit per returned record; fixed detail and metrics routes cost 1, 2, or 5 credits

The public overview contains `active_jobs`, `active_companies`, `active_sources`, and nullable `last_updated_at`. It does not expose listings, company profiles, source health, raw payloads, protected history, customer records, or operator tooling.

## Machine-readable contracts

- [Jobs Data OpenAPI 3.1](https://www.exende.dev/openapi/jobs.json)
- [Callback OpenAPI 3.1](https://www.exende.dev/openapi/callback.json)
- [Retry OpenAPI 3.1](https://www.exende.dev/openapi/retry.json)
- [Resolve OpenAPI 3.1](https://www.exende.dev/openapi/resolve.json)
- [API catalog](https://www.exende.dev/api/catalog.json)
- [Extended agent context](https://www.exende.dev/llms-full.txt)

Callback costs $0.01 USDC, Retry costs $0.02 USDC, and Resolve costs $0.01 USDC on their x402-paid paths. They use x402 v2 exact settlement on Base Mainnet (`eip155:8453`). Use each current PAYMENT-REQUIRED response for authoritative settlement requirements and never hardcode the recipient address.

## Jobs Data customer contract

- Jobs OpenAPI 3.1: https://www.exende.dev/openapi/jobs.json
- Developer quickstart: https://www.exende.dev/docs/jobs#quickstart
- Coverage and methodology: https://www.exende.dev/coverage
- Customer base URL: https://data.exende.dev
- Authentication: organization bearer API key; scoped jobs:read, companies:read, or signals:read.
- GET /v1/jobs/search requires q; GET /v1/jobs accepts optional q and normalized filters.
- GET /v1/jobs/{id}; GET /v1/jobs/{id}/history; GET /v1/history; GET /v1/skills.
- GET /v1/companies/{domain}; GET /v1/companies/{domain}/jobs; GET /v1/companies/{domain}/hiring.
- GET /v1/metrics/overview; GET /v1/metrics/hiring.
- Jobs list, search, and company jobs: default limit 50, maximum 100; pass nextCursor as cursor while retaining filters. Order: last_seen_at DESC, id DESC. Pages are not a frozen snapshot.
- Job history: up to 100 versions with limit, no cursor. Skills and history feed: latest/top 100, no pagination parameters.
- Hiring window: days 7–90, default 30. Hiring acceleration is null until historical readiness is met; it is not a prediction.
- Errors use error.code and error.message. Codes include unauthorized, insufficient_scope, invalid_request, rate_limited, insufficient_credits, not_found, service_unavailable.
- A Jobs Data 402 insufficient_credits response is not an x402 payment challenge. Callback, Retry, and Resolve have separate x402 contracts.
- The free allowance is 2,500 credits for 14 days for new verified organizations. Paid plan selection requires explicit checkout confirmation.
- Location text is not a normalized city. Country codes are nullable and require explicit supported evidence.

Public catalogue preview: GET https://data.exende.dev/v1/public/search?q=engineer (no key). q only, at most 80 characters and 6 terms. Returns actual active-job aggregates plus at most 5 restricted sample jobs from a fixed pool of at most 12 across all searches. No pagination, full descriptions, bulk export, customer data, or operator metadata. Country/location counts describe explicit country evidence and source location labels, not normalized cities. Full customer access requires a scoped Jobs Data API key. See https://www.exende.dev/docs/jobs#public-search.

## EXENDE JOBS INTELLIGENCE

Structured hiring intelligence for AI agents. Pay per request with x402. No API keys required for x402 access. No subscriptions required for individual x402 requests.

These seven GET routes extend the existing https://api.exende.dev service and share its payment configuration: /v1/jobs/search ($0.02 USDC), /v1/jobs/company ($0.05), /v1/jobs/signals ($0.09), /v1/jobs/changes ($0.04), /v1/jobs/skills ($0.05), /v1/jobs/trends ($0.09), /v1/jobs/report ($0.25).

- Production contract: https://www.exende.dev/openapi/jobs-intelligence.json
- Search maximum 10 jobs; signals maximum 5 companies; period 7d only; no cursor or offset pagination.
- Current queries use at most 10,000 recent active jobs, company-scoped when specified. Read coverage.sampled and sample denominators; full-catalogue totals are null when sampled.
- Historical cohorts over 5,000 jobs are not calculated. Disappearing jobs do not prove hires. Skills describe current deterministic associations, not historical demand.
- No AI inference. Statistics cover the monitored catalogue, not the global labour market. Source freshness differs from report generation time.
- Existing scoped-key Jobs Data subscriptions remain unchanged.
- All seven routes are deployed. Live unpaid challenges, free CDP discovery validation, real paid response/schema checks and on-chain USDC settlement checks passed on 2026-10-19. A repeated settled payment was rejected with HTTP 409. Eight-endpoint marketplace visibility remains pending. Existing marketplace service: https://agentic.market/services/api-exende-dev
- Payments support x402 v2 exact USDC on Base through EIP-3009 authorization. Other payment representations are rejected before upstream access or settlement.

## Test Inbox · Available

- Status: Available. Private email reception is activated.
- Product: https://www.exende.dev/products/test-inbox
- Documentation and runnable TypeScript quickstart: https://www.exende.dev/docs/test-inbox
- OpenAPI: https://www.exende.dev/openapi/test-inbox.json
- POST https://api.exende.dev/v1/inboxes: $0.02 USDC per new inbox via x402 v2 exact on Base (eip155:8453).
- Limits: 24 hours; up to 3 accepted messages; 1,048,576 bytes per email; wait up to 60 seconds per call. No outbound email or attachments.
- Required request fields: access_token (client-generated 32 random bytes encoded as 64 hexadecimal characters, saved before payment), expected_from (exact case-insensitive SMTP envelope sender mailbox, not the display From header). Optional subject_contains, otp_length (4–8, default 6), link_host.
- Use Authorization: Bearer <access_token> for GET /v1/inboxes/lookup, GET /v1/inboxes/{id}/messages, GET /v1/inboxes/{id}/wait?timeout=60&after={message_id}, and DELETE /v1/inboxes/{id}. Never put the token in a URL. These operations have no additional payment.
- Recovery: lookup returns creation metadata. Repeating POST with the same token and identical body returns HTTP 200 without another payment while the inbox is active; a different body returns HTTP 409. The server does not generate another read token.
- Message fields: id, received_at, from, subject, text, text_truncated, otp, verification_url, otp_status, link_status. Extraction statuses are found/not_found/ambiguous; link_status is not_requested without link_host. Missing or ambiguous extracted values are null.
- Wait returns HTTP 200 with received, timeout, message (nullable), and next_after. Use next_after as the next after cursor. No endless polling loop.
- The sender filter is not sender authentication. Verification URLs require an exact HTTPS hostname supplied as link_host; Exende never opens those URLs.
- Processing budget: at most 30 incoming email processing attempts per inbox, including invalid MIME and subject mismatches; at most three messages are stored.
- Unconfirmed payment settlement: creation returns HTTP 502 and lookup returns HTTP 409 while pending. Preserve the same token and body; do not authorize a second independent payment.
